name: SundaeSwap
description: AMM DEX on Cardano that executes orders in batches through licensed 'Scooper' batchers to reduce on-chain contention. One of the first major DEXes on Cardano.
notes: Trading app is at app.sundae.fi; the legacy sundaeswap.finance domain redirects to sundae.fi. Asset list combines ADA, the SUNDAE token, and the stablecoins named on the product pages; it is directional, not a TVL-ranked pool list. V4 docs describe concentrated liquidity and automated routing, but live status was not verified, so those are not reflected in capabilities.
